headline: Status updates on city-owned properties, including Perkins Street parcels, 81 Church Avenue, and Union Street lots, plus a health district lease.
summary: The agenda lists old business on city properties. It includes a lease with the Bristol Burlington Health District for the BEALS Senior Community Center and status reports on several properties.
items: Set schedule of regular meetings for 2027
